QUOTE: `MBEDTLS_PLATFORM_MEMORY` off (default) | `calloc` ... `MBEDTLS_PLATFORM_MEMORY` alone | `mbedtls_calloc()` in `library/platform.c:47`

VERDICT: MISS

WHY: The answer treats MBEDTLS_PLATFORM_MEMORY as the switch and says it is off by default. It never says the option is commented out in the shipped mbedtls_config.h, and "off (default)" is not that statement.
